notes: In China, 爷爷 refers specifically to your father's father. Your mother's father is called 外公 (wài gōng).
Because 爷爷 is a term of respect, it is also common to use it as a polite way to address any elderly man, even one you are not related to.

examples.translation: My grandfather is seventy years old this year.
examples.emotion: fond and matter-of-fact, sharing a simple family detail
